name: LangChain MCP
tagline: Use LangChain's LLM and tool abstractions from your MCP-compatible agent.
shortDescription: The LangChain MCP adapter. Lets you use any LangChain-supported LLM, tool, or retriever as an MCP tool. Bridges the LangChain ecosystem (100+ integrations) with the MCP protocol.
longDescription:
## What it is

The LangChain MCP server, maintained by the LangChain team. Acts as a bridge between MCP and the LangChain ecosystem: any tool, retriever, or LLM defined in LangChain can be exposed as an MCP tool your agent can call.

## Why we recommend it

If you already have LangChain tools (custom retrievers, document loaders, vector store wrappers, etc.), this is the easiest way to make them available to your MCP-compatible agent. You write the tool in LangChain, expose it via this server, and any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) can use it.

## When to use it

- You have existing LangChain tools you want to expose
- You want to use LangChain's vector store / retriever integrations from your agent
- You're building a multi-LLM workflow that needs to mix Claude, GPT, and local models
installInstructions:
1. Install: `uvx langchain-mcp`
2. Configure your LangChain tools in a Python file or notebook
3. Reference them in the MCP server config

**Note:** This is more of a bridge than a standalone server. You'll typically have other LangChain components that this server wraps.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. LangChain itself is open source. You pay only for the LLM API calls.
